messages:
sarah: Hey team — proposal: a 3-week mini-series of bite-sized tutorials and one small OSS refapp called 'embed-plugin-example' to show plugin-style connectors + embeddings. Goal: community onboarding + lead capture.

nate: Love that. What does the cadence look like? Weekly parts? Short vids?

sarah: Plan: Week1 tutorial (text + code + GIF), Week2 refapp release with sample data & quickstart, Week3 webinar + live build. Short vids (60-90s) + 2 blog posts.

jun: For the refapp, do we want a benchmark narrative comparing embedding index latency on hosted vs dedicated? I can run an index build and query latency, plus cost-per-query calc.

amanda: Yes — include both latency and dollars per 1k queries. Also show caching benefits for repeated queries. That will help conversion messaging.

devrel: I'll prep three demo clips: install, build index, query. Can produce a condensed 90s montage for social. Where do we store assets?

sarah: Put them in the repo under /assets/tutorials/embed-plugin-example/video. Add GIFs under /assets/tutorials/embed-plugin-example/gifs. Tag release v0.1.0.

nate: For launch comms: blog post + tweet thread + community post on Discord/GitHub Discussions. Also a short how-to on HackMD for contributors. We should have two headline variants for social: instructional vs outcome-driven.

amanda: Copy direction: Outcome-driven headline focuses on "turn your app into a search assistant in 10 minutes". Instructional leans on "How to build an embedding connector with Redwood". We'll A/B test both on Twitter and in the newsletter.

jun: For benchmarking, I'll produce a small matrix: dataset sizes (10k/50k/200k vectors), model variants (open-embedding-1, small-hosted), and deployment modes. ETA 48 hours for the first pass.

sarah: Great. Inbound lead routing: tag signups with "tutorial_embed_plugin" and route orgs with >100 employees to SDR; others to nurture sequence with follow-up tutorial suggestions. Also add field for "interested_in_plugins" checkbox.

amanda: Growth, can you add UTM scheme: utm_source=community, utm_medium=tutorial, utm_campaign=embed_plugin_series, utm_content={variant}? Also capture referrer for Discord posts.

growth-bot: Task created: MARKETING-4325 "Embed plugin mini-series launch" assigned to amanda. Due in 3 weeks. :spiral_calendar: Automated reminder set.

devrel: Quick question on license for sample data — can we include a small public dataset? Legal ok?

amanda: Legal greenlit a synthetic dataset for the examples. Use CC0 and mention it's synthetic in the README.

nate: Promo plan: 1) soft launch to community newsletter + Discord, 2) blog + GitHub release, 3) webinar next week for hands-on session. We'll pin the GitHub Discussion thread for feedback.

sarah: Can marketing draft the blog outline? Suggested sections: why embeddings + plugins, quickstart (code), performance notes, migration tips, contribution guide.

amanda: On it — will share outline by EOD tomorrow. Also will write two CTAs: "Try the refapp" and "Talk to Sales".

jun: Benchmarks uploaded to repo under /benchmarks/embed-plugin-series/2123456789-results.csv and README with commands and environment details.

devrel: Videos uploaded to GH release v0.1.0 and GIFs attached to the community post.

sarah: Nice. Any blockers?

amanda: Only blocker is final copy for blog intro. I'll do a quick internal review tomorrow 11am PT.

nate: I'll schedule the webinar with engineering hosts. Prefer Thurs 10am PT.

sarah: Perfect. Appreciate the quick turnaround everyone — target publish date is 3 weeks from now.

growth-bot: Follow-up scheduled: MARKETING-4325 check-in in 72 hours.

amanda: Thanks team :rocket:
